# I will now fetch all liked songs by paging through the results (max 20 per page).
liked_songs = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=spotify_login_response["access_token"], page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    liked_songs.extend(page)
    if len(page) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1

steps.code:
# I have the current song queue of length 23.
# I need to remove all songs from the queue that are in the liked songs list.
# The queue songs and liked songs both have song_id, so I will find positions of liked songs in the queue and remove them.
liked_song_ids = {song["song_id"] for song in liked_songs}

# Collect positions of songs in queue that are liked
positions_to_remove = [index for index, song in enumerate(song_queue) if song["song_id"] in liked_song_ids]

# Remove songs from queue starting from the highest index to avoid shifting issues
for position in sorted(positions_to_remove, reverse=True):
    apis.spotify.remove_song_from_queue(access_token=spotify_login_response["access_token"], position=position)
